description: Create a native Lemongraph task when requested. Accepts a title and optional Markdown content, dueDate (YYYY-MM-DD), priority, one tag, and participant emails. A tag is 1–20 characters and can include emoji and spaces; omit it for Inbox. A due date is a calendar day, not a timed reminder. Do not invent missing values. Send an idempotencyKey; repeating a call with the same key returns the same task.
name: create_task
title: Create task
